LanguageData.SCWC_SettingsUnavailable: These settings are unavailable. Another mod has changed the shipcracker warcasket's definitions, so the set keeps its built-in values.
LanguageData.SCWC_FuelPerJumpDesc: The amount of fuel each breach jump burns. At 0, jumps burn no fuel. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_TankCapacityDesc: The amount of fuel the armor's tank holds when full. A tank already holding more than this loses the excess. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_JumpRangeDesc: The maximum distance a breach jump can carry the pilot. Aerial warcasket parts add their own jump range on top. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_CooldownDesc: The time the pilot must wait after a jump before jumping again. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_JumpSummary: A full tank holds {0} {1}, enough for {2} jumps at {3} {1} each.
LanguageData.SCWC_BlastRadiusDesc: The radius of the blast when the pilot lands. At 0, landings cause no blast. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_RoofRadiusDesc: The radius of roof torn open around the pilot at takeoff and landing. Below 1, only the roof over the pilot's own cell opens; at 0, roofs are left intact. A jump within a single room never breaks the roof, and overhead mountain always holds. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_CreatureDamageDesc: The damage the landing blast deals to each person, animal or mechanoid caught in it. The pilot is never harmed. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_ArmorPenetrationDesc: The armor penetration of the landing blast's damage to creatures. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_ArmorPenetrationMPaDesc: The armor penetration of the landing blast's damage to creatures, in megapascals as Combat Extended rates blunt armor. For comparison, a frag grenade's blast penetrates about 17, and flak armor rates 12. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_WallDamageDesc: The damage the landing blast deals to walls and other structures that block movement. For comparison, a steel wall has {1} hit points and a plasteel wall {2}. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_StructureDamageDesc: The damage the landing blast deals to doors, turrets, furniture and other structures that do not block movement. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_ShouldersBonusDesc: The extra damage a landing deals to walls and other structures while the pilot wears the shipcracker warcasket shoulders. Creatures take no extra damage. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.SCWC_LandingSummary: Without the shoulders: {0} to a wall, {1} to other structures, across {2} cells.\nWith the shoulders: {3} to a wall, {4} to other structures.
LanguageData.SCWC_VacuumBurnDesc: When enabled, the jump becomes the breach burn in vacuum: unlimited range, but only to a target in line of sight. When disabled, jumps in vacuum follow the same rules as under gravity. Default: on.
LanguageData.SCWC_LandingBlastDesc: Toggle the landing blast.\n\nWhen disabled, breach jumps land without the blast that breaks walls and hurts anyone nearby. This is useful for jumping around your own base. Roofs in the way are still torn open.
